definitions.explanation: A formal conjunction used to present an alternative option. More formal than または and used in written or official contexts.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}もしくはメールでご{連絡|れんらく}ください。
examples.english: Please contact us by phone or email.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}もしくはクレジットカードでお{支払|しはら}いいただけます。
examples.english: You can pay by cash or credit card.

examples.japanese: {本人|ほんにん}もしくは{代理人|だいりにん}が{窓口|まどぐち}にて{手続|てつづ}きしてください。
examples.english: The person themselves or a representative should complete the procedure at the counter.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal conjunction used primarily in written language, legal documents, official notices, and business communication. In order of formality: もしくは (most formal) > または (formal) > それとも (conversational, for questions) > か (casual).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- または: or — slightly less formal, widely used in writing
- それとも: or — used in questions in conversation
- {或|ある}いは: or, possibly — similar formality, can also mean "perhaps"
